purpose: Exploratory live-cloud rendering cost measurements; no production candidate selected.

experiment.sourceFrameRatePolicy: Unchanged native driver requests current screen maximum capped at 120; experiment uses the 120 Hz internal screen.
experiment.formalCPU: Observed collector, performance recording off, 6 s warmup, 8 s formal, N10, idle.active and body.
experiment.diagnosticGPU: Separate observed idle.active run with NativePerformance detailed; command-buffer GPU times only after completed handlers, zero/unavailable never a successful timing.
limits: No new full regression tests at user request

protocol.display: Built-in Retina Display, mode and maximum 120 Hz, scale 2
protocol.sourcePacing: sparse: 2 reasoning packets/s/card, 64 bytes/packet; 512-byte message boundary
protocol.interpretation: App CPU observations and diagnostic per-command GPU durations only. No statistical A/B inference, physical FPS, device-wide GPU utilization or energy claim.
